title: WriteFile
description: Write a file with the given contents. Overwrites the file if it exists; creates it if it doesn't. A git checkpoint is created after the write. Requires user permission unless in yolo mode.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the workspace root or absolute. Must resolve to inside the workspace root.

content.description: The full contents of the file. Existing contents are replaced entirely; use edit_file for partial edits.

create_dirs.description: If true, create parent directories if they don't exist (mkdir -p).
